text:
alex_c: Heads-up — postmortem is up for the 03/19 auth+registry outage: https://redwood-internal/pm/200456. I opened the action tracker but want to confirm owners/timelines for vendor-related mitigations (cloud network flaps, model-registry auth expiry, third-party auth provider rotation).

maria_p: reviewing now. I think we should split into infra vs vendor tasks. infra (cloud network) -> eng-infra, vendor/auth -> security + vendor eng.

samir_r: can we get a short summary of recurring signal? are these independent failures or a pattern we can detect by metric?

alex_c: summary: three incidents in last 6 months where vendor auth TTL expired during a rollout (2x model-registry, 1x external auth), and two separate cloud network disruptions that correlated with control-plane retries. Pattern: token refresh gaps + cascading retries.

priya_ops: assigning owners:
- model-registry token rotation / refresh safety: owner maria_p -> due 2026-04-07
- external auth provider SLAs & failover plan: owner priya_ops -> due 2026-04-14
- cloud network retry/backoff hardening (eng-infra): owner alex_c -> due 2026-04-10

maria_p: ack. I'll add runbook updates and a test harness for token expiry scenarios. Plan: add an integration test that forces 401 on registry and asserts graceful fallback within 30s.

alex_c: adding short checklist for infra patch:
```
- increase exponential backoff cap to 60s for control-plane ops
- add circuit-breaker with cooldown after 5 failures/min
- publish metrics: registry_401_rate, auth_refresh_failures, network_retry_count
```

deploy-bot: Deployed branch "hardening/retries-2026" to staging at 2004568122.

samir_r: for recurring detection, suggest a monthly query that looks for clusters of auth_refresh_failures over baseline + spike correlation with deploy windows. I'll own the alert spec. Target: 2026-04-03.

priya_ops: for vendor SLAs: I'm asking legal to push for 99.9% auth token issuance SLA and 15-minute incident notifications. Also will draft a playbook for rotating to a backup provider if vendor misses SLA.

alex_c: action tracker updated: https://redwood-internal/actions/200456. owners/timestamps match above. We'll do a short sync in infra standup Friday to confirm staging test results (:eyes:).

maria_p: one more ask — add an automated smoke test that runs a token rotation scenario as part of the weekly canary. I'll open a PR for the harness.

alex_c: thanks. closing loop here: owners, due dates, runbooks + tests, vendor SLA ask, and monthly recurrence detection. If anyone needs to move a date, ping me on this thread. :thumbsup:
